title: Fourier-defined free Laplacian essential self-adjointness
statement: Prove essential self-adjointness of the Fourier-defined free Laplacian obtained by unitary conjugation of maximal multiplication by ξ² on L²(ℝ). This scoped card does not claim identification with the pre-existing Schwartz-core −D² operator or oscillator essential self-adjointness.
notes: The Fourier-defined free Laplacian is unconditionally ESA. Identification with the pre-existing Schwartz-core -D2 operator is still open and is not claimed.

attempts.note: Constructed maximal multiplication by xi^2 with explicit nonreal resolvents, proved ESA, and transferred it through Mathlib Plancherel. AXLE 4.32 and axiom probes clean.
